# Turbo Unit Converter

> Fast, precise unit conversion for length, weight, temperature, volume, and dozens more categories — with a NIST-traceable Learn library of 220+ engineering-grade explainers.

Turbo Unit Converter is a professional unit conversion tool with engineering-grade precision across SI, US Customary, and Imperial systems. Every conversion factor is verified against NIST SP 811 and the BIPM SI Brochure. The Learn library covers the conversions that trip people up in real work: turbo boost pressure, torque wrench units, fuel economy across regions, radiation dose, data-rate confusion, cooking cup mismatches, and more.

## Core pages

- [Home](/): Search and quick converters for the most common categories.
- [All converters](/converters): Browse every unit category.
- [Learn hub](/learn): Index of every explainer article, filterable by category.
- [Methodology](/methodology): How conversion factors are sourced and verified.
- [Editorial policy](/editorial-policy): Review and update policy for Learn articles.
- [About](/about): Who runs the site.

## Converter categories

- [Length](/c/length): meters, feet, inches, miles, nautical miles, ångström, light-years.
- [Weight](/c/weight): kilograms, pounds, ounces, tonnes, stones, grains, troy weight.
- [Temperature](/c/temperature): Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin, Rankine, Réaumur.
- [Volume](/c/volume): liters, gallons, cups, fluid ounces (US/UK), barrels.
- [Pressure](/c/pressure): pascal, bar, psi, atm, mmHg, torr, inHg.
- [Energy](/c/energy): joule, calorie, kilowatt-hour, BTU, therm, electronvolt.
- [Power](/c/power): watt, horsepower (mechanical/metric), BTU/hr, kVA.
- [Data](/c/data) & [Data transfer](/c/data-transfer): bits/bytes/binary vs decimal, Mbps vs MB/s.
- [Speed](/c/speed): m/s, km/h, mph, knots, Mach.
- [Fuel efficiency](/c/fuel-efficiency-volume): MPG (US/UK), L/100km, km/L.
- [Radiation](/c/radiation): sievert, gray, rem, becquerel, curie.

### Angle

- [Radians, Degrees and Gradians: Which and When](/learn/radians-degrees-gradians): Degrees for humans, radians for calculus, gradians for surveyors, mils for artillery. A pragmatic guide to picking the right angle unit…

### Area

- [Barns: The Unit Nuclear Physicists Named as a Joke](/learn/barns-cross-sections): 1 barn = 10⁻²⁸ m². Nuclear physicists named it because a uranium nucleus is 'as big as a barn' at that scale. Here is where the unit…
- [Carpet Ordering: Sq Yards vs Sq Metres vs Broadloom Widths](/learn/carpet-yards-meters-rooms): 12-ft broadloom = 3.66 m. 1 sq yd = 0.836 m². Rounding waste up front prevents 2-week reorder delays.
- [Hectares and Acres for Farmers](/learn/hectares-acres-farming): Yield per acre and yield per hectare do not convert with a round factor. Here is the exact math and why bushels-per-acre and…
- [Home Size: sq ft vs sq m vs Marla vs Tsubo](/learn/home-square-footage-meters): 1000 sq ft = 92.9 m². Global real estate uses local units: marla (25.29 m²), tsubo (3.31 m²), pyeong (3.31 m²).
- [Square Kilometers vs Square Miles: Country Size Comparisons](/learn/sq-km-sq-mi-country-sizes): Every country reports its area in one unit and expects the reader to convert. Here is the exact factor and a set of mental anchors for…
- [Square Feet and Square Meters in Real Estate](/learn/sqft-sqm-real-estate): Apartments listed at 800 sq ft rarely convert to a round metric number. Here is the exact factor, and the local measurement conventions…

### Capacitance

- [µF, nF, pF: Capacitance Units for Real Circuits](/learn/capacitor-uf-nf-pf): 1 µF = 1000 nF = 10⁶ pF. Bulk decoupling in µF; RF bypass in nF; timing and matching in pF. Off by a decade means broken circuit.
- [Farads and Microfarads: Reading Capacitor Codes](/learn/farads-microfarads-capacitor): A '104' capacitor is 100 nF. Here is the three-digit EIA code and the F/µF/nF/pF ladder every electronics hobbyist needs.

### Charge

- [Amp-hours and Watt-hours: Battery Capacity Explained](/learn/amp-hours-watt-hours-batteries): A 100 Ah battery and a 100 Wh battery are not comparable. Here is why voltage matters and how to convert battery specs across chemistries.
- [Battery Chemistry: LiFePO4 vs Lead-Acid Usable Wh](/learn/battery-lifepo4-vs-lead-acid-wh): 100 Ah lead-acid @ 50% DoD = 600 Wh usable. 100 Ah LiFePO4 @ 90% DoD = 1152 Wh — nearly 2× real energy.
- [Battery Capacity: mAh, Wh, and 100 Wh Airline Limit](/learn/battery-mah-wh-airline-limits): Wh = mAh × V / 1000. TSA limits carry-on batteries to 100 Wh. A 27,000 mAh power bank at 3.7 V = 99.9 Wh — right at the line.
- [Coulomb, mAh, Ah: Charge Units and Battery Capacity](/learn/coulomb-ampere-hour-charge): 1 A·h = 3600 C. A 3000 mAh phone battery is 10 800 C. Confusing energy (Wh) with charge (Ah) is the number one battery-spec error.

### Concentration Molar

- [Moles and Molarity: Reading Chemistry Recipes](/learn/moles-avogadro-chemistry): One mole is 6.022 × 10²³ particles. Here is how to weigh out a mole, dilute a molar solution, and convert between molarity and mass…

### Concentration-molar

- [Blood Glucose: mg/dL vs mmol/L](/learn/blood-glucose-mgdl-mmol): 1 mmol/L = 18.02 mg/dL for glucose. US uses mg/dL; most of the world uses mmol/L. CGM apps switch confusingly.
- [Cholesterol Units: mg/dL vs mmol/L](/learn/cholesterol-mgdl-mmol): For cholesterol, mmol/L × 38.67 = mg/dL. Triglycerides use × 88.57. Different molecule, different factor.
- [pH Scale: [H⁺] in mol/L Explained](/learn/ph-scale-hydrogen-ion-molarity): pH = -log₁₀[H⁺]. pH 4 = 10⁻⁴ M. Each unit is 10× — vinegar (2.4) is 4000× more acidic than tomato (4.6).

### Concentration-solution

- [Water Hardness: ppm vs GPG vs French Degrees](/learn/water-hardness-ppm-gpg-grains): 1 GPG = 17.1 ppm CaCO₃. 1°fH = 10 ppm. Water softener sizing uses GPG in US, ppm in EU.

### Cooking & Volume

- [Cooking Conversions: Why Grams Beat Cups Every Time](/learn/cooking-conversions-grams-vs-cups): A US cup of flour can weigh anywhere from 120 g to 155 g depending on the scoop. Here is why serious bakers weigh, and how to convert…

### Data

- [Bits vs Bytes: Marketing Storage Sizes](/learn/bits-vs-bytes-storage): A 1 TB drive holds 931 GiB of files. Here is why the storage industry uses decimal units while your operating system uses binary, and…
- [Cloud Storage Billing: GiB vs GB Costs](/learn/cloud-storage-gib-vs-gb-billing): AWS charges per GB (10⁹). Local file managers show GiB (2³⁰). A '100 GB' bucket showing 93.1 GiB is correct.
- [GB vs GiB, MB vs MiB: The 4.9% Storage Discrepancy](/learn/iec-vs-si-storage): 1 GB = 10⁹ bytes (SI). 1 GiB = 2³⁰ = 1.074 × 10⁹ bytes (IEC). Drive manufacturers use SI; operating systems mostly show IEC. The 7% gap…
- [Mobile Data: How Long Does 5 GB Last?](/learn/mobile-data-gb-month-video): 1 hour Netflix HD = 3 GB. Instagram scroll = 700 MB/hr. Zoom video = 900 MB/hr. Realistic 5 GB month math.
- [Phone Storage: '128 GB' vs Actual Usable Space](/learn/phone-storage-gb-vs-real): 128 GB advertised = 128,000,000,000 bytes = 119.2 GiB. OS eats 15-25 GB. Users see ~95 GB usable.

### Data Transfer

- [Gbps and Mbps: What Your Internet Speed Really Means](/learn/gbps-mbps-network-throughput): A 1 Gbps fibre plan does not download files at 1 GB/s. Here is the bit-vs-byte math and the overheads that eat the rest.

### Data rate

- [Mbps vs MB/s: The ×8 Trap That Tricks Every New Broadband Customer](/learn/mbps-vs-mbs-the-x8-trap): Your 100 Mbps plan does not download at 100 MB per second — it downloads at 12.5 MB/s. Here is why, and where the network overhead goes.

### Data-transfer

- [4K vs 1080p: Bitrates and Storage](/learn/4k-vs-1080p-bitrate): 1080p HEVC ≈ 8 Mbps. 4K HEVC ≈ 25 Mbps. Netflix caps 4K at 15 Mbps. Compression hides the pixel math.
- [HDD vs SATA SSD vs NVMe: MB/s Real Numbers](/learn/hdd-vs-ssd-mb-s): 7200 RPM HDD: 150 MB/s. SATA SSD: 550 MB/s. NVMe Gen4: 7000 MB/s. Bus limits vs media limits.
- [Internet Speed: Mbps vs MB/s Download Times](/learn/internet-speed-mbps-mbs-download): 1 GB file at 100 Mbps = 82 seconds. ISPs quote bits; browsers show bytes. The /8 factor confuses everyone.
- [DDR4 vs DDR5 Bandwidth: MT/s vs GB/s](/learn/ram-ddr4-ddr5-bandwidth): DDR4-3200 = 25.6 GB/s per channel. DDR5-5600 = 44.8 GB/s. MT/s ≠ MHz — the doubling is real.
- [Wi-Fi 6 'Gigabit' vs Real Throughput](/learn/wifi-6-gbps-real-throughput): Wi-Fi 6 rated 1.2 Gbps ≈ 700 Mbps real. Overhead, MIMO streams, channel width — the marketing math.

### Density

- [kg/m³, g/cm³ and API Gravity: Density Across Disciplines](/learn/kgm3-gcm3-api-gravity): Water is 1,000 kg/m³, or 1 g/cm³, or 10 °API… almost. Here is how physics, chemistry and petroleum engineering describe the same…

### Digital-image-resolution

- [Monitor PPI: 4K 27" vs 1440p 27" vs 5K](/learn/monitor-ppi-4k-27-inch): PPI = √(w² + h²) / diagonal. 4K 27" = 163 PPI. Retina target = 218 PPI. Text scaling math.
- [Camera Megapixels vs Sensor Size](/learn/smartphone-camera-mp-vs-sensor-size): Megapixels ≠ image quality. Sensor area matters more. iPhone 1/1.28" @ 48 MP vs full-frame 24 MP.

### Distance & Speed

- [Nautical Miles, Knots and Why Aviation Still Uses Feet](/learn/nautical-miles-knots-aviation-feet): The aviation world runs on nautical miles, knots and feet — and there are surprisingly good reasons why the last hold-out of Imperial…

### Dry volume

- [Dry vs Wet Volume: Bushels, Dry Quarts and the Trap](/learn/dry-vs-wet-volume): 1 US dry quart = 1.101 L. 1 US liquid quart = 0.946 L. 16% difference. Grain sold in dry, milk in liquid — same word, different unit.

### Dynamic viscosity

- [Pa·s, cP, Poise: The Three Names for Dynamic Viscosity](/learn/viscosity-pas-cp-poise): 1 Pa·s = 10 P = 1000 cP. Water at 20 °C is 1 cP. Oil at 40 °C is 30–500 cP. SI insists on Pa·s; industry keeps cP.

### Electric field strength

- [Electric Field Strength: V/m, kV/mm and Dielectric Breakdown](/learn/electric-field-strength-v-m): 1 kV/mm = 10⁶ V/m. Air breaks down at 3 kV/mm; PET film at 300 kV/mm; SF₆ at 89 kV/mm. Miss the unit and insulation design fails.

### Electric resistivity

- [Resistivity and Conductivity: Ω·m, Ω·cmil/ft, S/m, %IACS](/learn/resistivity-conductivity-units): Copper is 1.72 × 10⁻⁸ Ω·m = 100% IACS. Aluminium is 61% IACS. Silver is 106% IACS. Cable ampacity scales inversely.

### Energy

- [Calories vs Kilojoules on Food Labels](/learn/calories-kilojoules-food-labels): 1 kcal = 4.184 kJ. EU/AU labels use kJ; US uses kcal (labelled 'calories'). Convert your daily intake.
- [Calories vs Kilocalories: The Food-Label Fudge](/learn/calories-vs-kilocalories-food): A 'calorie' on a US food label is actually a kilocalorie. Here is why nutrition co-opted the unit and how to reconcile it with the joule.
- [Joule, Calorie, kWh, BTU, eV: One Chart, Every Energy Unit You'll Meet](/learn/energy-units-reconciled): 1 kWh = 3.6 MJ = 860 kcal = 3412 BTU = 2.25 × 10²⁵ eV. Same energy, different disciplines' vocabularies.
- [Electronvolts: The Currency of Atomic Physics](/learn/ev-electronvolt-atomic): Chemistry uses eV. Nuclear physics uses MeV. Particle physics uses GeV and TeV. Here is what an electronvolt actually is and where each…
- [Gasoline vs Diesel Energy Density](/learn/gasoline-vs-diesel-energy-density): Gasoline 34.2 MJ/L. Diesel 38.6 MJ/L (13% more). Explains diesel's better MPG at same displacement.
- [Joules, Calories, kWh, BTU: One Energy, Four Dialects](/learn/joules-calories-kwh-btu-reconciled): Utility bills, food labels, thermodynamics texts and HVAC catalogs each use a different energy unit. Here is exactly how they line up,…
- [kWh and MWh: Reading an Electric Bill](/learn/kwh-mwh-electric-bills): Your house is billed in kWh. Your factory is billed in MWh. A power plant produces GWh. Here is how the units scale and how to…
- [Therms and CCF: How Natural Gas Is Billed](/learn/therms-ccf-natural-gas): US gas utilities bill in therms or CCF. Neither is a familiar unit. Here is what they mean and how to convert to kWh or MJ.
- [Water Heater: BTU/hr vs kW vs Therms/Month](/learn/water-heater-btu-kwh-therms): 40,000 BTU/hr = 11.72 kW gas. Electric heater: 4.5 kW. Therms billing: 1 therm = 29.3 kWh. Cost math.

### Flow

- [Barrels per Day: The Oil Industry's Flow Unit](/learn/bbl-day-oil-production): OPEC quotes production in million barrels per day. Here is how bbl/d converts to m³/h, litres/second and real refinery throughput.
- [CFM and m³/h: Sizing Ventilation](/learn/cfm-m3h-ventilation): US HVAC catalogs quote fans in CFM. European catalogs quote in m³/h or L/s. Here is the exact factor and how to size ductwork consistently.
- [GPM, LPM, m³/h: The Pump-Curve Trio](/learn/gpm-lpm-m3h-pump-conversion): 1 US gpm = 3.785 L/min = 0.2271 m³/h. Pump curves from US, EU and IEC vendors all use different units on the same graph.
- [CFM, SCFM, ACFM: The Compressed-Air Units That Aren't Interchangeable](/learn/scfm-vs-acfm-vs-cfm): ACFM is actual volumetric flow at line conditions; SCFM normalises to standard T and P. At 100 psig, 1 ACFM ≈ 7.8 SCFM.
- [VO2 Max: ml/kg/min and MET Equivalents](/learn/vo2-max-ml-kg-min): VO2 max in ml O₂/kg/min. 1 MET = 3.5 ml/kg/min. Convert lab results to daily-activity language.
- [Volumetric vs Mass vs Molar Flow: Which Rate Does Your Process Actually Care About?](/learn/volumetric-vs-mass-vs-molar-flow): Volumetric flow (m³/h) is what pumps deliver. Mass flow (kg/h) is what heat balances need. Molar flow (kmol/h) is what reactions…
- [Shower Flow Rate: GPM vs LPM Regulations](/learn/water-flow-gpm-lpm-shower): US federal cap: 2.5 GPM = 9.46 LPM. EU eco-label: 6-9 LPM. Same shower head labelled differently.

### Fluid permeability

- [Permeability: Darcy, Millidarcy and m²](/learn/permeability-darcy-m2): 1 darcy = 9.869 × 10⁻¹³ m². Reservoir sandstones are 10–1000 md; shales are <0.01 md. Pump curves and well design run on this factor.

### Force

- [Dyne vs Newton: CGS vs SI](/learn/dyne-newton-cgs-si): 1 N = 100,000 dyne. Legacy physics texts and older biophysics papers still use dynes. Muscle physiology in dynes/cm².
- [Newtons, kgf and lbf: Why Weight Is Not Mass](/learn/newtons-kgf-lbf-weight-vs-mass): A 100 kg mass weighs 100 kgf on Earth and 16.5 kgf on the Moon. Here is how the kgf and lbf survived alongside the newton, and where the…

### Frequency

- [Earthquake Magnitude: Richter vs Moment vs Mercalli](/learn/earthquake-magnitude-richter-mw): Richter M4 → M5 = 10× amplitude, 32× energy. Modern USGS uses Moment magnitude (Mw). Mercalli is felt intensity.
- [Audio Frequency Response: 20 Hz - 20 kHz Reality](/learn/frequency-response-hz-audiophile): Human hearing: 20 Hz - 20 kHz theoretical, 40 Hz - 16 kHz typical adult. Speaker specs oversell high end.
- [Heart Rate Zones: %HRmax vs %HRR (Karvonen)](/learn/heart-rate-zones-percentage): %HRmax and %HRR give different zone boundaries. Zone 2 at 70% HRmax ≠ 70% HRR. Coaches disagree — here is why.
- [Hertz, Megahertz, Gigahertz: The Radio Spectrum](/learn/hz-mhz-ghz-radio-spectrum): AM radio is at kHz. FM at MHz. WiFi at GHz. 5G at both. Here is the full spectrum map and what each band is used for.
- [Noise Dose: dBA vs OSHA/NIOSH 8-Hour Limits](/learn/noise-dba-osha-hearing): OSHA 90 dBA/8 hr. NIOSH 85 dBA/8 hr. Every +3 dB halves safe exposure. Concerts hit 110 dB — 30 s limit.
- [RPM and Hertz: Motor Speeds and Grid Frequency](/learn/rpm-hz-motor-speeds): A 60 Hz motor spins at a different speed than a 50 Hz motor. Here is why grid frequency dictates every industrial motor's RPM and how to…
- [Running Cadence: Steps per Minute](/learn/running-cadence-spm): 180 spm is the coaching target. Elite runners actually range 170-200. Cadence × stride = pace — the math.
- [Wavelength vs Frequency vs Photon Energy](/learn/wavelength-frequency-photon-energy): λ·f = c. E = hf. Visible 400-700 nm = 430-750 THz = 1.77-3.1 eV. Three ways to describe one photon.

### Fuel economy

- [MPG (US) vs MPG (UK) vs L/100km: Fuel Economy Without Bragging Rights](/learn/fuel-economy-mpg-us-uk-l100km): A 40 mpg car in the US and a 40 mpg car in the UK do not sip fuel at the same rate. Here is the exact conversion and why L/100 km is the…

### Fuel-efficiency-volume

- [EV Efficiency: kWh/100mi vs Wh/mi vs MPGe](/learn/ev-range-kwh-per-100mi): Tesla Model 3: 250 Wh/mi = 25 kWh/100mi. MPGe uses 33.7 kWh/gal equivalent. EPA math translated.
- [MPG US vs UK vs L/100km: EPA vs WLTP](/learn/mpg-us-uk-l100km-real): 30 mpg US = 36 mpg UK = 7.84 L/100km. EPA and WLTP test cycles diverge further. Real vs sticker.

### Heat flux density

- [Heat Flux Density: W/m², BTU/(h·ft²) and Solar Constant](/learn/heat-flux-density-units): Solar constant: 1361 W/m² = 431 BTU/(h·ft²). Comfortable radiant panel: 200 W/m². Combustion flame: >100 kW/m². Scales matter.

### Heat transfer coefficient

- [Heat Transfer Coefficient: W/(m²·K) and BTU/(h·ft²·°F)](/learn/heat-transfer-coefficient-units): 1 W/(m²·K) = 0.176 BTU/(h·ft²·°F). Natural convection air: 5–25 W/(m²·K). Boiling water: 3000–100 000. Choice of h dictates…

### Illumination

- [Lumens vs Lux vs Candela: Bulbs, Rooms, Torches](/learn/lumens-vs-lux-vs-candela): Lumens = total output. Lux = lm/m² at a surface. Candela = directional intensity. Three different questions.
- [Lux and Foot-Candles: Lighting Design](/learn/lux-footcandles-photography): US lighting codes quote foot-candles. Everywhere else quotes lux. Here is the exact factor and how to hit an IES-recommended illuminance…

### Inductance

- [µH, mH, nH: Inductance Units in Power and RF](/learn/inductance-uh-nh-mh): 1 mH = 1000 µH = 10⁶ nH. Power inductors in µH–mH; RF chokes in nH–µH; PCB trace inductance in nH per mm.

### Kinematic viscosity

- [Kinematic Viscosity: cSt, SUS and ISO VG Grades](/learn/kinematic-viscosity-cst-sus): 1 cSt = 1 mm²/s. ISO VG 32 is 32 cSt at 40 °C. SUS is a legacy timed-flow measurement. Confuse the columns and pump sizing drifts.

### Length

- [Altitude: Feet vs Meters in Aviation and Hiking](/learn/altitude-feet-meters-aviation): Cruising 35,000 ft = 10,668 m. Everest 8848 m = 29,029 ft. Aviation is ft globally; hiking varies.
- [Angstroms and Nanometers: Wavelengths and Bond Lengths](/learn/angstrom-nanometer-wavelength): Chemists still write bond lengths in ångströms. Physicists write wavelengths in nanometres. Here is why both units survive and how to…
- [Brake Disc Thickness: mm vs Thou Wear Limits](/learn/brake-disc-thickness-mm-inch): New disc 25 mm. Wear limit 23 mm. US thickness gauges read in thou (0.001"). 2 mm = 78.7 thou wear.
- [Clothing Sizes: US vs UK vs EU vs Asian Fits](/learn/clothing-sizes-international): US 6 = UK 10 = EU 36 = Asian L. Same waist/bust cm mapped to different labels. Online shopping trap.
- [Drill Bits: Metric vs Fractional vs Number/Letter Sizes](/learn/drill-bit-metric-vs-fractional): 1/4" = 6.35 mm. Nearest metric: 6 or 6.5 mm. Tap drill charts assume one system — swapping shifts thread engagement.
- [Hiking Elevation Gain: Cumulative vs Net](/learn/hiking-elevation-gain-loss): Cumulative gain sums every uphill segment. Net = end - start. Trail difficulty depends on cumulative — apps disagree.
- [Inch Fractions and Decimals: A Reference Chart](/learn/inch-fractions-decimals): A 3/16 drill is 0.1875 in = 4.7625 mm. Here is the full fraction-to-decimal-to-mm table, and why fractional inches survive in modern shops.
- [Kilometers and Miles: What Road Signs Actually Mean](/learn/km-miles-road-signs): Speed limits, distance markers and odometer readings change units at almost every border. Here is the exact factor, and the mental math…
- [Astronomy Distances: AU, Light-Year, Parsec](/learn/light-year-parsec-au-distances): 1 AU = 150 M km. 1 ly = 63,241 AU. 1 pc = 3.26 ly. Solar system uses AU; galactic uses pc.
- [Light-years, Parsecs and Astronomical Units](/learn/light-years-parsecs-au): Astronomers switch units by discipline: AU for planets, parsecs for stars, light-years for the public. Here is how the three scales…
- [Lumber: 2x4 Nominal vs 38x89 mm Actual](/learn/lumber-dimensional-nominal-actual): '2x4' = 1.5" × 3.5" = 38 × 89 mm. Planing loses 1/2" per dimension. Metric-imperial framing math.
- [Meters to Feet — and the US Survey Foot Nobody Talks About](/learn/meters-to-feet-and-the-us-survey-foot): There are two feet in the United States. Confusing them puts survey markers hundreds of feet off across a country. Here is the story.
- [Nautical Mile vs Statute Mile vs Kilometre: When 'Mile' Isn't 'Mile'](/learn/mile-nautical-vs-statute): 1 nautical mile = 1852 m. 1 statute mile = 1609.344 m. Aviation and marine navigation are in nautical; road signs in statute.…
- [Millimeters and Inches on the Shop Floor](/learn/mm-inches-precision-machining): A 0.001-inch tolerance is not a 0.01 mm tolerance. Here is how to convert cleanly between mm and inches without accumulating rounding…
- [Mils, Microns and Thou: Precision Length in Machining](/learn/precision-length-mils-microns-thou): Thousandths of an inch, micrometres, mils and gauge numbers all describe fractions of a millimetre. Here is how machinists switch…
- [Shoe Sizes: US vs UK vs EU vs Japan](/learn/shoe-size-us-uk-eu-jp): US 10 = UK 9 = EU 43 = JP 28. Half sizes step 4.23 mm. Cross-country buying charts differ 1 size.
- [Steps to Kilometres and Miles: The Real Math](/learn/steps-to-km-miles): Average stride: 0.76 m for men, 0.67 m for women. 10,000 steps ≈ 7.6 km or 4.7 mi. Why fitness trackers disagree.
- [Swimming: Short Course Meters vs Yards vs Long Course](/learn/swimming-pool-lengths-meters-yards): SCY = 25 yd, SCM = 25 m, LCM = 50 m. World records split by pool type. Times don't convert linearly.
- [Tire Sizes: 225/45R17 vs Overall Diameter](/learn/tire-size-metric-vs-inch): 225/45R17: 225 mm wide, 45% aspect ratio sidewall, 17" rim. Overall diameter = 631 mm = 24.8".
- [Yards and Meters on the Sports Field](/learn/yards-meters-sports-fields): American football measures in yards. Track and field measures in metres. Soccer stadiums straddle both. Here is the conversion, and the…

### Lumber volume

- [Board Foot, Cord, Cubic Foot: Lumber Volume Units](/learn/board-foot-vs-cubic-foot): 1 board foot = 1 ft × 1 ft × 1 in = 144 in³. 1 cord = 128 ft³ of stacked wood. Different products, different conventions.

### Magnetic Flux

### Magnetism

- [Amp-Turn, Oersted, A/m: Magnetic Field Strength Units](/learn/amp-turn-oersted-ampere-per-meter): 1 Oe = 79.577 A/m. Amp-turn = current × turns and drives H directly. Coil designers, transformer engineers and NDT technicians all need…
- [Nanotesla: The Units of Geomagnetic Surveys and UXO Detection](/learn/geomagnetic-nt-anomaly-mapping): Earth's field averages 50 000 nT. Buried steel objects cause anomalies of tens to hundreds of nT. Magnetometers read to 0.01 nT.
- [Flux vs Flux Density: Weber, Tesla and When They Are Not the Same](/learn/magnetic-flux-vs-flux-density): Flux (Wb) is total field through a surface; flux density (T) is field per unit area. 1 T = 1 Wb/m². Confusing them mis-sizes transformer…
- [Tesla and Gauss: The 10,000-to-1 Split in Magnetism](/learn/tesla-gauss-magnetic-flux-density): One tesla equals 10,000 gauss. Simple arithmetic; deep history. How SI and CGS diverged in magnetism and why MRI, geophysics and…
- [Tesla, Gauss, Millitesla: MRI, Speakers and the Earth's Field](/learn/tesla-gauss-mri-earth-field): 1 T = 10 000 G. Earth's field is 0.5 G; a fridge magnet 50 G; a 3 T MRI is 30 000 G. Same physics, wildly different regimes.

### Magnetomotive force

- [Magnetomotive Force: Ampere-Turns and Gilberts](/learn/magnetomotive-force-units): MMF = NI, in ampere-turns. 1 Gb = 10/(4π) At ≈ 0.7958 At. Reluctance networks convert MMF to flux the way voltage drives current.

### Moment-of-inertia

- [Moment of Inertia: kg·m² vs slug·ft²](/learn/moment-of-inertia-slug-kg): 1 slug·ft² = 1.356 kg·m². Aerospace uses slugs; SI uses kg·m². Rotor inertia specs still mixed.

### Permeability

- [Permeability Units: H/m, µ_r and Why Iron is 1000× Air](/learn/permeability-units-henry-per-meter): µ₀ = 4π × 10⁻⁷ H/m. Relative permeability µ_r is dimensionless. Iron alloys hit µ_r = 5000+; mu-metal 100 000+.

- [Sugar Weights: Granulated, Brown, Powdered per Cup](/learn/sugar-brown-vs-granulated): 1 cup granulated = 200 g. Brown packed = 220 g. Powdered = 120 g. Same volume, wildly different weights.
- [Barbell Plates: kg vs lb Loading](/learn/weightlifting-plates-kg-lb): 20 kg bar = 44.09 lb. Adding 45 lb plates ≠ 20 kg plates. Gym conversions cost you PRs.
- [Yeast: Fresh vs Active Dry vs Instant Conversions](/learn/yeast-fresh-active-instant): 1 g instant = 1.25 g active dry = 3 g fresh. Bread recipes rarely specify — here is the exact ratio.
